name: Eden MCP API
description:
Eden's agent API is a hosted [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) (Model Context Protocol) server. Agents speak JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP to `POST https://mcp.eden.so/mcp` and get 110 tools (namespaced `eden_*`) covering outlier research across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Substack, private analytics, boards and notes, and scheduling/publishing.

**Connect (MCP clients):** add a remote MCP server at `https://mcp.eden.so/mcp`. Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http eden https://mcp.eden.so/mcp`. Claude.ai/Desktop: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Auth is OAuth 2.0 (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration per RFC 7591, discovery per RFC 8414/9728).

**Connect (plain HTTP, e.g. n8n/Zapier/Make):** create an API key in Eden under Settings → API and send it as `Authorization: Bearer eden_pat_…` on every request.

**REST, no MCP client:** every tool also runs as `POST https://mcp.eden.so/v1/tools/<name>` with its arguments as the JSON body (spec: https://mcp.eden.so/v1/openapi.json). The store API (sales, customers, products, email list, webhooks) has its own spec: https://api.eden.so/store-app/v1/openapi.json.

**Tool errors:** tools return structured JSON. Failures are `{ ok: false, status, message }` — `status` says whether to fix input (`invalid`), reconnect (`auth-expired`), or surface to the user. Never retry an `invalid` payload unchanged.

The full tool catalog is enumerated under the top-level `x-mcp` extension, and in human/agent-readable form at https://eden.so/llms-full.txt.
